translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content.text: Yave niandi kiezila kiama ayi phulusu ama.
Nani ndilenda mona tsisi e ?
Yave niandi suamunu kingolo mu luzingu luama.
Nani ndilenda mona boma e ?
Mu thangu batu bambimbi, bela kuiza ku ntualꞌama
mu diambu di dia nsuni ama ;
mu thangu bambeni ziama ayi bobo bandendi bela kuiza kunduanisa,
bela bumina thutu ayi bela bua.
Ka diambu ko nkangu wu masodi wunzungididi,
ntimꞌama wulendi mona tsisi ko ;
Ka diambu ko mvita yibuidi mu diambu diama,
ndilendi zimbisa diana ko.
Kima kimosi ndilomba kuidi Yave,
kiawu ndintomba :
Thidi vuanda mu bilumbu bioso bi luzingu luama mu nzo Yave,
mu diambu nditalanga kitoko ki Yave
ayi mu diambu ndintombannga mu nzo andi.
Bila mu lumbu ki ziphasi
wela ku kheba mu luvovomo mu buangu kiandi kamvuandanga ;
wela kutsueka ku tsi Nzoꞌandi yi ngoto ;
wela kuthedimisa va ditadi di ngolo.
Buna ntu ama wulenda vumuka va yilu bambeni ziama zinzungididi.
Mu nzoꞌandi yi ngoto, ndiela tambika makaba mu khini.
Ndiela yimbila ayi bula miziki mu diambu di Yave.
Wa mbemboꞌama bu ndilembo tedi, a Yave ;
wumboni kiadi ayi wuphana mvutu.
Ntimꞌama wutubidi mu diambu diaku :
“Tomba zizi kiandi.”
Zizi kiaku, a Yave, kiawu ndiela tomba.
Kadi kutsueka zizi kiaku.
Bika kuka kisadi kiaku mu nganzi.
Ngeyo wuba nsadisi ama
kadi kumbika, kadi kundiekula.
A Nzambi yi Mvulusi ama.
Ka diambu ko dise diama ayi ngudi ama bandiekudi ;
Yave wela kundiakula.
Wundonga nzilꞌaku, a Yave
ayi wundiatisa mu nsolo wu songa
mu diambu di batu bobo beti kundiamisa.
Kadi kundiekula mu luzolo lu batu bobo beti kundenda,
bila bambangi ba luvunu zitelimini
mu diambu diama,
ayi zieti yindula matsita.
Ndisia diana mu diambu diadi :
Ndiela mona mamboti ma Yave va ntoto wu batu badi moyo.
Tadidila Yave !
Wukikindisa ayi bika ntimꞌaku wukinda ;
ayi tadidila Yave.
